mutations: Recompute unrelated outer reference/authorization hashes where needed so each semantic mutation reaches its intended check; preserve only the intentionally mismatched counterpart. Never rehash away a deliberate digest mismatch.
live_evidence: No real ledgers/native identities/human application records are copied or synthesized. AUTH-001 procedure cases use explicitly fictional transcripts and cannot authorize live recovery.
